en.headline: sogeisetsu opens a bug report and two idea discussions on openchamber
en.summary: On 2026-10-09 the user recorded **0 own commits** across all repositories, with 23 additional automated commits in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` created by `github-actions[bot]`. No pull requests, reviews, or releases were produced. The user opened issue `#4601` in `openchamber/openchamber`, titled "[Bug] Switching model in the composer keeps the previous thinking level instead of the model's own default", and later commented on the same issue; `openchamber-bot[bot]` replied with a maintainer note tagging the issue as `fix-ready` and confirming that `defaultVariant` is a single global profile setting applied to every model offering that variant id. The user also started two discussions in `openchamber/openchamber`: `#4599` "[Idea] Give agents a supported way to read and change OpenChamber settings (tool, CLI, or MCP)" in the Ideas category, and `#4600` "[Idea] Let an extension expose something the agent can call, or document the file workflow" in the Extensions category. Both discussions currently have 0 comments. Overall totals for the day: 0 commits, 0 PRs, 2 issues, 0 reviews.
